jobs.description:
About The Role

The Data Analyst turns product, customer, and operational data into reliable analysis that supports product decisions, growth planning, and business performance. The role works across SQL-based warehouses such as Snowflake or BigQuery, dbt models, and BI tools to define metrics, investigate trends, and make complex data accessible to decision-makers.

The analyst partners with product managers, engineers, and business leaders to build trusted reporting and answer high-priority questions with rigor. This role matters because consistent metric definitions, well-designed dashboards, and clear analysis directly influence how teams allocate resources and measure outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Query and analyze large datasets using SQL to identify trends, explain performance changes, and answer recurring and ad hoc business questions
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting in Looker, Tableau, or Mode, ensuring stakeholders have timely access to accurate metrics
Define, document, and monitor core business and product metrics in partnership with product, finance, marketing, and operations teams
Develop reusable data models and transformations in dbt, applying testing and documentation standards to improve reporting reliability
Investigate data quality issues by tracing discrepancies across source systems, warehouse tables, pipelines, and downstream dashboards
Design analyses for experiments, funnels, cohorts, retention, and segmentation; communicate findings with clear recommendations and appropriate caveats
Present concise written and visual analyses to technical and non-technical audiences, translating ambiguous questions into measurable decisions

What We Are Looking For

1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, product analytics, or a related quantitative role
Advanced SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and query optimization on analytical datasets
Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks SQL
Experience building production dashboards and self-service reporting in Looker, Tableau, Mode, Power BI, or an equivalent BI platform
Working knowledge of data modeling and transformation practices, including dbt, dimensional modeling, metric definitions, and data quality testing
Strong analytical communication skills, with the ability to explain methodology, limitations, and recommendations to varied stakeholders
Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, computer science, business analytics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent practical experience considered. Bonus: Python or R, experimentation analysis, Amplitude or Mixpanel, Airflow, and experience working with product or marketplace data

WSP USA Inc is currently seeking a Senior Geologist
to work out of our office in Canton, MS
Provides technical assistance and guidance for multi-site/phase environmental work processes, due diligence, subsurface investigation, and remediation projects. Determine well-defined data collection methods for extracting, identifying, and compiling environmental data from soil sampling, soil gas sampling, groundwater sampling, stormwater sampling, boring logs, and other matrices for projects, investigations, and surveys.
Assist with environmental site assessments (Phase I and II).
Research environmental hazmat databases regarding historical property land uses.

Experience with UST investigations and remediation including investigation of hydro-carbon impacted sites.

Proficiency with technical writing, office automation and communication software, technology, and tools.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The NYISO’s Market Solutions Engineering team invites applications for a full-time Market Solutions Engineer.

The Market Solutions Engineer will support the electric power system model used by the scheduling and dispatch software. This individual will develop and apply a working knowledge of the New York State high voltage transmission system and the network model database software to support the NYISO market and security functions. Additionally, the Market Solutions Engineer will support the real-time power system analysis, primarily the EMS software applications and BMS software applications, the development and evolution of the Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Energy Market Systems (BMS), and the development and evolution of the Smart-Grid application software. Strong Power Systems or Electrical Engineering with power system software and/or mathematical optimization knowledge is desired for this position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and implement PMU application functions in coordination with NY Transmission Owners and neighboring control areas.
Provide Power System Operations Dispatcher support and Operator training for all Smart-Grid applications such as, ePDC, RTDMS (Server and Client), ePDE and Grid-Smarts.
Develop and maintain software and operating procedures to address special market and operating conditions.

Perform the development of the documentation to support new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects including the new EMS/BMS platform.

Perform regression test for new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects to ensure the correct market outcomes including the new EMS/BMS platform.

None required.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The NYISO’s Market Solutions Engineering team invites applications for a full-time Market Solutions Engineer.

The Market Solutions Engineer will support the electric power system model used by the scheduling and dispatch software. This individual will develop and apply a working knowledge of the New York State high voltage transmission system and the network model database software to support the NYISO market and security functions. Additionally, the Market Solutions Engineer will support the real-time power system analysis, primarily the EMS software applications and BMS software applications, the development and evolution of the Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Energy Market Systems (BMS), and the development and evolution of the Smart-Grid application software. Strong Power Systems or Electrical Engineering with power system software and/or mathematical optimization knowledge is desired for this position.

Perform the development of the documentation to support new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects including the new EMS/BMS platform.

Perform regression test for new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects to ensure the correct market outcomes including the new EMS/BMS platform.

Bachelor's degree (BS) in Electrical Engineering or related technical field required; Course studies in power systems, electrical engineering, power system components (generation and transmission equipment, concepts and principles) and mathematical modeling of power system components required; Master’s degree (MS) in Electrical Engineering desired.

The Program Coordinator is responsible for overall program management including the planning and execution of structured group activities. Additionally, the Program Coordinator serves as the main contact for referrals and to the administration where the program will be housed. They maintain connections with parents, school personnel and other outside programs who are involved in the student's lives.

ESSENTIAL & CORE FUNCTIONS:

Maintains policies and procedures of the program, assuring compliance with each
Serve as point person for emergencies
Reports to the Sr. VP of Operations any and all emergencies and/ or problems
Plan, develop and provide a nurturing, structured and enriching program of after school activities for students

Implement a Strength Based Youth Development Approach in all interactions and programs with youth and their families

Provide individual assistance to students or families as needed
